description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a chessboard UI, including rendering the grid, pieces, and drag-and-drop interactions.

classes.name: ChessBoard
classes.description: A Flutter widget representing a chessboard with interactive drag-and-drop functionality.

classes.name: _BoardGrid
classes.description: A private widget for rendering the chessboard grid and handling square highlights.

classes.name: _PiecesLayer
classes.description: A private widget for rendering chess pieces and handling drag-and-drop on the board.

classes.name: _DraggablePiece
classes.description: A widget for rendering a draggable chess piece.

classes.name: _SquareDropTarget
classes.description: A widget that acts as a drop target for chess pieces.

methods.name: _displayToSquare
methods.description: Converts display coordinates to a Square object, considering board flip.

methods.name: _squareTopLeft
methods.description: Calculates the top-left offset of a square on the board.

methods.name: _pieceSymbol
methods.description: Returns Unicode symbol for a given chess piece.
